name: maxio-sdk-exp1-agents
description: EXPERIMENTAL VARIANT of maxio-sdk (map + skills, v0.1.1 data layer plus generated map enrichments: operation Notes from XML remarks, literal enum member names, namespaces, literal-parameter-name headers) adding subagent orchestration: an integrate-maxio router, a maxio-plan agent that produces a map-grounded contract sheet with no open lookups (resolving map-side gaps from SDK source itself), a maxio-debug agent whose first step on SDK-name compile errors is opening the exact source file the map names, and a maxio-sdk-clone agent that owns all SDK-source cloning. Tests whether procedural structure rescues weak models and cuts main-context cost. Not for production install.
